title: constraints.grant_scope: a fix round may carry extra scope entries that the scope guard, the packet and the daemon dirty-scope check honour, so the Planner widens scope without a respec
spec:
Goal T-1403, wave 2, plan label E7 (analysis 2026-10-01). Today a fix round inherits the held task's scope
(daemon.auto_fix_round passes current['scope']); when the fix needs one more file (A1 and A6 in wave 1 died on
pinned tests outside scope) the Planner must supersede and refile the whole task.

Facts (goal/T-1403 at 92c1a98 plus T-1458 and T-1459 merged before this task; re-check line numbers):
- .claude/hooks/scope-guard.sh:7-20 reads `.scope[]` of the task json and blocks Edit/Write outside it (exit 2).
- scopes.py:14-30 safe_scope(task, worktree) returns task.write_scope or task.scope entries contained in the
  worktree; spawn.py:812 renders write_scope into the packet from `scope`; daemon.py:1230-1249
  _dirty_scope_paths(worktree, scope) and the gate's dirty check use task['scope']; several read-only modules
  (context_router.py:118, evidence.py:51, jev_skills.py:52, memory_hot.py:72, memory_scorecard.py:52,
  jev_sched.py:87) read scope or write_scope for ranking only and stay as they are.
- bus.create_task validates scope non-empty (TaskCreated hook); constraints is a free dict.

Change:
1. scopes.effective_scope(task) -> list: task['scope'] + (task.get('constraints') or {}).get('grant_scope') or
   [], deduplicated, order kept; grant entries go through the same containment rules as safe_scope. safe_scope
   uses effective_scope.
2. scope-guard.sh: also accept globs from `.constraints.grant_scope[]?` (same loop, both lists), and name both
   lists in the block message.
3. spawn packet (812): write_scope lists effective_scope; daemon gate dirty check and any other write-time
   scope read in daemon.py (grep "\\[\"scope\"\\]" and ".get(\"scope\")" in daemon.py and spawn.py) use
   scopes.effective_scope(task). auto_fix_round keeps copying scope and now also copies constraints.grant_scope
   (it already spreads constraints).
4. bus.create_task: when constraints.grant_scope is present, validate it is a list of non-empty relative path
   strings without '..' (ValueError otherwise) and record it in the creation event; no other bus change.

Tests that assert the old behaviour (SPEC RULE): tests/test_scopes.py safe_scope tests (grep 'safe_scope') pass
unchanged; the hook tests in tests/test_hooks.py or tests/test_scope_guard*.py (grep 'scope-guard' under tests/)
pass unchanged and gain the grant case; tests/test_daemon.py dirty-scope gate tests (grep '_dirty_scope_paths' /
'executor did not commit'). Run tests/test_scopes.py, tests/test_spawn.py, tests/test_daemon.py, tests/test_bus.py and
the hook tests.

Depends on B5 T-1458 (daemon.py chain) and B8 T-1459 (spawn.py chain). Out of scope: mcp.py, executor.py.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused tests in the foreground; never
background a command and never run the full gate. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py
like the neighbouring tests.

Re-filed 2026-10-01 (replaces T-1461): depends_on re-pointed to T-1474, T-1476 after the B2v3/B4v3 respecs; the spec, acceptance and scope are unchanged.

Re-filed 2026-10-02 (replaces T-1477): depends_on re-pointed to T-1496, T-1498 after the round-3 respecs (B2v4, B4a/B4b, E12v3); spec, acceptance and scope unchanged.
acceptance: tests/test_scopes.py::test_effective_scope_includes_grant_scope: passes: scopes.effective_scope of a task with scope ['a/'] and constraints.grant_scope ['tests/test_b.py'] is ['a/', 'tests/test_b.py'], safe_scope keeps the grant entry when it is contained in the worktree and drops '..' entries; a task without grant_scope is unchanged

tests/test_hooks.py::test_scope_guard_accepts_grant_scope: passes: scope-guard.sh allows a write to a path matched only by constraints.grant_scope and still blocks a path outside both lists with a message naming both

tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_dirty_check_and_fix_round_honour_grant_scope: passes: a done execute task with an uncommitted file under its grant_scope is reported by the gate's dirty-scope check (held 'executor did not commit'), and auto_fix_round's fix round carries the parent's constraints.grant_scope

tests/test_bus.py::test_create_task_validates_grant_scope: passes: bus.create_task rejects grant_scope entries that are not strings, are empty, are absolute or contain '..', and accepts a list of relative paths
